invariants: Overdue status must never be treated as proof of fraud or bad faith
PAID requires authoritative payment reconciliation evidence
Disputed invoices must pause automated collection reminders and route to human review
Reminder cadence and channel must be approved before customer contact
No collection message may misrepresent legal action, suspension or service termination
Funded milestone status must be derived from reconciled payment evidence
Partial payment must not be represented as fully PAID
Cashflow dashboard must distinguish invoiced, due, overdue, disputed and collected amounts
Customer contact must respect communication preferences and applicable commercial terms
Collections control cannot alter invoice amount, waive debt, issue refund or suspend service without human authority
